exposure: early preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) prior to 26 weeks
preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) prior to 26 weeks
cohort: 46 fetuses from 23 multifetal pregnancies complicated by PPROM before 26 weeks
finding: In multifetal pregnancies complicated by very early PPROM, neonatal survival to hospital discharge was 43%, but only 17% survived without significant neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The study found that the fetus with ruptured membranes was more likely to experience intrauterine demise but otherwise had similar outcomes as the fetus with intact membranes, including mode of delivery.
